messages:
nina (product): Tiny recap from today's roadmap call: we must finalize the embeddings ingest contract (sync vs async), explicit dims support, and a clear fallback/downsample policy so sales can commit pilots.

raj (eng-platform): Proposal: two supported sync modes and one async. Sync-lowlatency: dims <=2048, max_vectors=128. Sync-bounded: dims up to 2048, max_vectors=1024 but higher 95p latency. Async-ingest: accept up to 100k vectors and dims up to 4096 (jobs, 202).

zoe (eng-ml): Perf caveat: 4096 on hosted = expensive tails. Recommend 4096 for Dedicated only by default. Allow hosted async 4096 with strict queue/priority to avoid OOM. Add server-side downsample option: client can request downsample_to=2048.

kai (infra): Autoscale: async queue shards + per-customer concurrency. Add headers X-ETACandidate and X-Queue-Priority. Circuit breaker returns 429 when memory pressure is high.

sam (sales): Customers want deterministic ETAs for nightly loads. If we offer async with SLA tiers (standard 0-12h, expedited <2h) we can close deals. Also need pricing multiplier for dims>2048.

raj (eng-platform): API sketch: POST /v1/embeddings (sync) - synchronous responses for small requests. POST /v1/embeddings?async=true - returns {job_id, eta}. Response shape stays the same: {model, dimensions, embeddings, meta}. Meta includes requested_dimensions and downsampled=true if applied.

zoe (eng-ml): Fallback behaviour: if model/dim unsupported -> 400 with error code unsupported_dimensions, suggestion field with options (use Dedicated, async, or downsample). Also support 202 async for very large sync attempts.

nina (product): Launch criteria: OpenAPI + SDK helpers (polling + webhook), perf matrix published, pricing decision for >2048, Dedicated pilot for 4096. Owners: @raj API, @zoe perf, @kai infra, @nina customers.

deploy-bot: Plan: feature/embeddings-ingest -> staging 2024-07-12T09:00Z (dry-run).

nina (product): OK next sync Friday to review draft spec. If objections, ping me.
